name: brum
description: A local development companion for worktrees, apps, ports, logs, and coding-agent tasks.

typography.wordmark: Use brum-logo-horizontal.png for the original marketing lockup; the app uses lowercase Geist Variable at weight 900 with -0.065em letter spacing.
typography.note: The original concept board is reference only. src/client/styles.css is authoritative for application semantic colors and typography.

usage.background: Use the bare transparent engine without a tile, circle, border, or frame. The petrol marketing wordmark belongs on light surfaces. The app wordmark inherits the current theme foreground.
usage.clearSpace: Start with one cap-height around the full logo; preserve generous breathing room.
usage.colors: Petrol for text, paper for main surfaces, machine for mascot and emphasis, oxide sparingly. Do not use yellow text on cream.
usage.smallSizes: Use public/brand/brum-engine-{16,32,48,64,96,180}.png at the corresponding pixel size. Sidebar: 32 CSS px with 64/96 sources for 2x/3x. Favicon: 16/32/48 PNG with ICO fallback; touch icon: 180 PNG.
usage.voice: Warm, clear, capable. Short concrete copy; friendly without baby talk.

assetStatus: Approved raster assets reused from the original brand kit. No new image generation. Concept board preserved under reference; its icon tile, font samples, and surface examples are superseded by the current app. No vector master is claimed.
